milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate close to the green bed (center at spawn-relative 0, 0, 8) and face toward it. max_distance=5 requires the player to actually enter the shelter (spawn is 8 blocks away, so they must walk at least 3 blocks forward). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the bed, confirming visual identification.

Uses inventory_has because picking up an item means it ends up in the player's inventory. The diamond is summoned as an item entity at (~2, 0, ~6) near the shelter entrance with PickupDelay=0, so walking over it automatically adds it to inventory. The player starts with no diamond in inventory, so min_count=1 confirms successful pickup.
